Fix landed and verified, 2026-11-11 19:29 PST.
- Change 3355 merged as d583578c4da (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; make verify rc=0: 21,019 + 218 passed). It has 2 parts. (1) mcp-entrypoint.sh recovers the interrupted fast-forward: index tree == a commit on HEAD..origin/main, nothing unstaged or untracked, compare-and-swap ref move, against the last fetched main even when the remote is unreachable. Otherwise it refuses with an MCP_CODE_WORKSPACE_ERROR marker. (2) The autodeploy steady-state tick probes the live backend's workspace and emits AUTODEPLOY_ERROR mcp-code-workspace-stuck when it is dirty, unreadable, exec-failed, or its HEAD lacks the live image's commit; the existing rebar-autodeploy-errors alarm pages on that. Tests reproduce the stuck state with a real repo (tests/infra/test_mcp_entrypoint.py) and run the real probe script (tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py); negative controls confirmed the recovery, the unstaged guard and the behind check each fail their test when removed. No config key, env var or flag.
- Production after deploy (read-only SSM): mcp-deployed-sha d583578c4da; live container rebar-mcp-d583578c4da3-8093; MCP_CODE_DIR HEAD d583578c4da == main, 0 porcelain entries; the deployed entrypoint contains the recovery; 0 mcp-code-workspace-stuck markers in the last 10 min.
- Close-path check: before the repair, a close verified at 3835269d792 with sonnet-4-6 (itchy-neutral-whooper). After the repair, the MCP close of 2473-79b7-1048-4a71 at 16:52 PST verified at fdf0a94aba8, which was main's tip at that moment (committed 16:44 PST), with ran_model bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5. This bug's own close below is a further data point.
- Root cause recorded above: an OOM kill of rebar-mcp-e2ed08b343a2-8092 at 2026-10-28 17:47:26 PDT, mid-refresh.
- Residual, filed separately (not this bug): juiced-anarthrous-bird. The workspace refreshes only at container start, so between MCP-path deploys a close verifies against the last MCP deploy's commit, not main.
